en.text: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧建造房屋， 凿成七根柱子，

zhTraditional.text: 智慧建造房屋， 鑿成七根柱子，

en.text: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

zhSimplified.text: 宰杀牲畜， 调和旨酒， 设摆筵席；

zhTraditional.text: 宰殺牲畜， 調和旨酒， 設擺筵席；

en.text: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

zhSimplified.text: 打发使女出去， 自己在城中至高处呼叫，

zhTraditional.text: 打發使女出去， 自己在城中至高處呼叫，

en.text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

zhSimplified.text: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！ 又对那无知的人说：

zhTraditional.text: 說：誰是愚蒙人，可以轉到這裏來！ 又對那無知的人說：

en.text: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

zhSimplified.text: 你们来，吃我的饼， 喝我调和的酒。

zhTraditional.text: 你們來，吃我的餅， 喝我調和的酒。

en.text: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

zhSimplified.text: 你们愚蒙人，要舍弃愚蒙， 就得存活，并要走光明的道。

zhTraditional.text: 你們愚蒙人，要捨棄愚蒙， 就得存活，並要走光明的道。

en.text: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

zhSimplified.text: 指斥亵慢人的，必受辱骂； 责备恶人的，必被玷污。

zhTraditional.text: 指斥褻慢人的，必受辱罵； 責備惡人的，必被玷污。

en.text: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

zhSimplified.text: 不要责备亵慢人，恐怕他恨你； 要责备智慧人，他必爱你。

zhTraditional.text: 不要責備褻慢人，恐怕他恨你； 要責備智慧人，他必愛你。

en.text: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

zhSimplified.text: 教导智慧人，他就越发有智慧； 指示义人，他就增长学问。

zhTraditional.text: 教導智慧人，他就越發有智慧； 指示義人，他就增長學問。

en.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

zhSimplified.text: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 认识至圣者便是聪明。

zhTraditional.text: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端； 認識至聖者便是聰明。

en.text: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

zhSimplified.text: 你借着我，日子必增多， 年岁也必加添。

zhTraditional.text: 你藉着我，日子必增多， 年歲也必加添。

en.text: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

zhSimplified.text: 你若有智慧，是与自己有益； 你若亵慢，就必独自担当。

zhTraditional.text: 你若有智慧，是與自己有益； 你若褻慢，就必獨自擔當。

en.text: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧的妇人喧嚷； 她是愚蒙，一无所知。

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧的婦人喧嚷； 她是愚蒙，一無所知。

en.text: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

zhSimplified.text: 她坐在自己的家门口， 坐在城中高处的座位上，

zhTraditional.text: 她坐在自己的家門口， 坐在城中高處的座位上，

en.text: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

zhSimplified.text: 呼叫过路的， 就是直行其道的人，

zhTraditional.text: 呼叫過路的， 就是直行其道的人，

en.text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

zhSimplified.text: 说：谁是愚蒙人，可以转到这里来！ 又对那无知的人说：

zhTraditional.text: 說：誰是愚蒙人，可以轉到這裏來！ 又對那無知的人說：

en.text: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

zhSimplified.text: 偷来的水是甜的， 暗吃的饼是好的。

zhTraditional.text: 偷來的水是甜的， 暗吃的餅是好的。

en.text: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

footnotes.text: 9:18 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 人却不知有阴魂在她那里； 她的客在阴间的深处。

zhTraditional.text: 人卻不知有陰魂在她那裏； 她的客在陰間的深處。
